$comment: Throw and catch tuning, GAME_DESIGN.md section 7. Throw.ts contains no literals.
$comment_ballMod: Orb tiers from the table in section 7. Keyed by the item id in items.json so the two cannot drift apart.
$comment_ring: The catch ring pulses inward. Releasing while it is small is worth a bonus, which is the skill in the throw.
$comment_terms: chance = clamp(base * hpTerm * levelTerm * ringBonus * ballMod * statusMod, 0.01, 0.95). hpTerm = 1 - (hp/maxHp) * hpWeight.
$comment_arc: Drag-and-release. The arc is previewed, so these govern both the preview line and the flight.
$comment_flee: Wild pals bolt at low health, GAME_DESIGN.md section 7. Retuned at the owner's direction: at 20%/25%-per-second a first fight usually ended with the target running away, which teaches nothing. Later and rarer keeps the pressure without stealing the catch (D55).
$comment_guarantee: The first-fifteen-minutes tuftmoth (Objectives.ts / objectives.json) must land on the first orb, or a new player can lose the game's first catch to bad luck before they know what a shake animation means. Applied only to that one scripted, docile pal, and only while the first_catch flag is unset; see Throw.ts ThrowInput.guaranteed.
$comment_suggest: The button-glow read (src/combat/Suggestion.ts). Enemy HP fraction at or below which the orb button is suggested: catchChance()'s hpTerm is 1 - hpFraction*0.75, so 0.35 nearly triples the catch odds over a throw at full health, which is what makes it a realistic attempt rather than a hopeful one.
